name: Password Recovery Code Rejected
summary: An anonymous user submits a password recovery code that is invalid, expired, consumed, or no longer eligible after the allowed attempts, and recovery does not advance to password replacement.
finalOutcome: No password is changed, no reset token is exposed to the user, and the user remains in recovery with a neutral invalid-or-expired-code result.

sourceReferences.note: VerifyPasswordResetCodeAsync intentionally returns the same public failure for malformed, unknown-user, expired, consumed, attempt-exhausted, and mismatched codes.
Different internal rejection reasons share one behavior because user-visible outcome and permitted next action are identical.
